title: Paypal misinformation fine ($2,500) - Close Your Accounts ASAP!

comments.author: @zxyatiywariii8
comments.text:
Well said!  I would never again want a PP account, ever since what they did to me a few years ago.
I had bought a tiny, $9.95 jade monkey charm from Ebay and paid via PayPal.  The sender sent it, I sent him or her my payment, and all was well.  But then --

A few days later, when I was trying to use PP, I discovered I'd been banned, because -- according to PayPal -- the seller lived in China and it was illegal to ship that type of jade out of that particular country. 

As if I'm supposed to know China's export laws?!  
The jade monkey is pretty, but it's not some national treasure or something.

I never even tried to get back on PP.  Any company that capricious and cowardly (blaming a nobody like me, but NOT the shop in China).

I knew PP was bad way back then, but now it's even worse.

As I was hanging up, the rep said, "Goodbye for now." Weird but not unexpected.
